notes.title: New Studio Website
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I'm happy to announce that Solohack3r Studios has a brand new website. And finally; a .com domain. [url=https://www.solohack3rstudios.com/]Solohack3rStudios.com[/url] is the new home for everything relating to the studio and my games. I hope you'll check it out!

-Nick

notes.title: Debt City Now Available on Android
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Debt City has been ported to Android. It's now available on Google Play. You'll now be able to take the sandbox city with you!

The game supports touch, gamepad, external keyboard, and devices like the Retroid Pocket.

[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.solohack3rstudios.debtcity]Get Debt City - Android Edition on Google Play![/url]

More to come.

-Nick

notes.title: Debt City Now Available
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45179503/386f12da7a418249ea61204d84d2bfec6604524a.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

Exciting News! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3387370/Debt_City/]Debt City is now available on Steam[/url].

Jump into the world of Debt City and experience an open sandbox city ready to explore. It's a slice of life sim with retro graphics, and no moral compass. Be a criminal, or be a regular citizen. The choice is yours.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3387370/Debt_City/][u]Download Debt City now and start playing![/u][/url]

Thanks to everyone for their support as always. More to come!

-Nick

notes.title: Debt City: The Wait is Over!
notes.content:
Get ready to experience the ultimate urban adventure! We're thrilled to announce that Debt City will officially launch on February 25th, 2025!

Join the journey through the gritty streets of Debt City, where strategy, wit, and determination will be your keys to success. Will you rise to the top or succumb to the challenges of this unforgiving metropolis?

Mark your calendars for February 25th and be among the first to explore Debt City!

Wishlist now and get ready to take on the city.

Stay tuned for more updates.

Thank you for your support, and we can't wait to welcome you to Debt City!
